# Subway Seat for Telegram

Sets all 586 keys of the Telegram Desktop palette, with a plain walnut chat background bundled in. Outgoing bubbles take a soft orange tint; media viewer and calls stay dark in every flavor. For Telegram Desktop only; the native macOS app doesn't take theme files.

[Telegram](https://desktop.telegram.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/telegram/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Telegram Desktop › Settings › Chat Settings:

```text
Choose from file › subway-seat.tdesktop-theme, then Keep changes
(opening the file with Telegram Desktop does the same)
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Telegram Desktop › Settings › Chat Settings:

```text
Choose from file › subway-seat-tunnel.tdesktop-theme, then Keep changes
(opening the file with Telegram Desktop does the same)
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Telegram Desktop › Settings › Chat Settings:

```text
Choose from file › subway-seat-enamel.tdesktop-theme, then Keep changes
(opening the file with Telegram Desktop does the same)
```

## Follow light and dark

In Telegram Desktop:

```text
Telegram keeps one theme for day and one for Night Mode (main menu › Night Mode):
with Night Mode off, open subway-seat-enamel.tdesktop-theme;
with Night Mode on, open subway-seat.tdesktop-theme (or subway-seat-tunnel);
then click Settings › Chat Settings › Auto-night mode until it reads System.
```

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
